name: Mileadha
text: Mileadha is a warped spelling of the Milesians' name. That people stand as the last of Ireland's mythic invaders in the pseudo-history Lebor Gabála.

attributes.attribute: corrupt form of the Milesians' name
name form tied to the last invading people of the pseudo-history
